chapter_title: Also concerning the Catechumen; shall he be saved
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶8:**

When, however, they are released from their merely natural and corporeal state of mind, they advance through successive spiritual states and pass through the higher degrees of understanding, and enter into genuine life , which is the conjunction of love and wisdom. They are purified by the infl ux of heavenly good and truth through the interior degrees of the mind; and the goods of charity they have brought forth are gathered to them , just as a work of life that has matured to full ness is separated from the perception that bore it.

**¶20:**

As for the rest, each particular of the will and understanding is examined; and he underg oes the painful vastation that answers to his ev ils and falsities. Afterward he is purified — whether through the interior degree of the mind or through the exterior and natural degree . He is purified in exact proportion to the quality of his works of life: ev ils are removed , falsities are dispers ed by tru ths, and he is cloth ed with the out ward truths that compose and beautify the external man . Afterward, he is reformed into a form of wisdom — the genuine human form shaped entirely by divine truth — and he is elevated through the interior degrees and enters into the state of heav enly peace .

---

* A note on " scul pted a light image": * This is among the most striking correspond ences in the passage . To be * sculpted* is to be reformed not by one self but by the Divine working as cause upon a recipient subject ; and a * light image* is the truly human form, which exists only ins ofar as wisdom from the Lord constit utes its substance. It corresponds closely to what Swedenborg calls the * form of heaven * impressed upon the individual spirit .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: when he comes out from his body, his soul shall [rise and shine] in the firmaments above, and he travels to the place of rest.

When, however, they come forth from their body, they travel on their way and pass by in the place above, and go in to the life. They shall be purified in the heavens, and they are plucked just as a fruit that ripens is plucked from the tree.

Afterwards he is purified, whether indeed above or below. He shall be purified according to the worth of his deeds, and cleansed and washed and adorned. Afterwards, he is sculpted a light image; and [he glid]es up and reaches the land of rest,
